QuestInfo.name: Battle Mode MVP
QuestInfo.0: Rosette, the Battle Square guide, told you that there is a Battle Mode challenge mission...
QuestInfo.1:
Rosette, the Battle Square guide, told you that if you win Team Match mode 3 times, she will give you a reward. Why not try it?

#rTip! You must win the Team Match mode 3 times in one day. If one day passes, your quest progress will reset.
QuestInfo.2: You have won Team Match mode 3 times and received a reward.

0.0: Hello, #h0#! I am Rosette, the Battle Square guide. Right now, I am handing out gifts to those who complete challenges.
0.1: You want a mission? Okay, I've got a mission for you. You have to win 3 Team matches throughout the day. How does that sound? You can do that, right?

yes.0: All right! Now, remember, you must win 3 Team matches throughout the day. And you only get one day...after that, you lose your progress. Got it? Good! Now get to it!

no.0: Where's all your confidence? This stuff is easy!

1.0: Hey, you did it! I had a feeling you could handle 3 wins. Nothing to it, right? 'Course not. So, here's your gift. I'm sure it'll come in handy.

yes.0: So, you're all set for another mission, right?

default.0: 아직 미션을 달성하지 못하신 건가요? 팀매치에서 3번만 승리하시면 되요. 어서 도전해보세요.
